headline: California CEO arrested over $300M Nvidia chip smuggling to China
summary: US authorities arrested a California tech CEO, identified as Greg Lui, accused of smuggling more than $300 million worth of export-controlled Nvidia-powered servers to China through Malaysia and Singapore using false paperwork. He faces up to 20 years in prison.

claims.statement: US authorities arrested a California CEO, identified as Greg Lui, for allegedly smuggling more than $300 million worth of Nvidia-powered servers to China.

sources.quote: U.S. authorities have arrested a California man accused of smuggling more than $300 million worth of export-controlled Nvidia-powered servers to China through Malaysia and Singapore, allegedly using false paperwork to conceal their final destination
US arrests tech CEO accused of smuggling $300M in Nvidia chips into China
Greg Lui allegedly used false paperwork to smuggle export-controlled gear from US to third countries and then China

claims.statement: The CEO faces up to 20 years in prison, and allegedly routed the shipments through Malaysia and Singapore.

sources.quote: California tech CEO arrested, faces up to 20 years in prison for smuggling $300 million in Nvidia AI servers to China
